name: media-redactor
description: Pixelate a region of an image or video to hide sensitive info before sharing it

tools.title: Detect Region to Redact (AI)
tools.description: Describe the region to redact in natural language (e.g. 'the folder sidebar on the left') and get back pixel coordinates {x, y, width, height} inferred by a vision-capable model. Requires path, description. Optional frameTimestamp (video only, default 0) picks which frame to analyze. Also writes the detected coordinates to a sidecar '<path>.detect-region.json' file next to the source, since the result itself isn't otherwise shown to the user. Fails with a specific message if no remote vision-capable model is configured — the caller should fall back to manual coordinate entry, not retry.

tools.title: Redact a Region
tools.description: Pixelate a fixed rectangular region of an image or video. Requires path, x, y, width, height, outputPath. Optional startTime/endTime (video only, seconds) limit the redaction to that time range — omit both to redact the whole duration. Refuses to overwrite an existing file at outputPath.

actions.title: Detect Region (AI)...
actions.description: Describe what to redact and let AI find the pixel coordinates, saved next to the file as '<name>.detect-region.json' — open it, then type the numbers into "Redact Region..." yourself

actions.title: Redact Region...
actions.description: Pixelate a region of this image or video
